vo_open.text: Australia once went to war with emus.

vo.text: About twenty thousand emus were eating farmers' crops in Western Australia.
vo.cap: About *20,000 emus* were eating the crops.

vo.text: So the army sent in two machine guns and ten thousand rounds of ammunition.
vo.cap: The army sent *2 machine guns.* *10,000 rounds.*

vo.text: The commander claimed nine hundred eighty-six kills, with nine thousand eight hundred sixty rounds.
He said they could face machine guns with the invulnerability of tanks.
vo.cap: "They can face machine guns with the *invulnerability of tanks.*"

vo.text: The army pulled out. Farmers asked for the military three more times. The answer was always no.
vo.cap: The army pulled out. Farmers asked *3 more times.* Always *no.*
